'''Gan Enok''' was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who accompanied fellow Master [[Denolm Orr]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Elom (planet)/Legends|Elom]] to investigate a link between the planet and [[Darth Malgus]].<ref name="Mission Abstract" />
